def: A suffix used to form the superlative of adjectives andadverbs; as, smoothest; earl(y)iest.
Of or pertaining to optimism; tending, or conforming, to theopinion that all events are ordered for the best.
A discourse or treatise on the heavens and the heavenly bodies;the study of the heavens; uranography.
In no degree; not at all. Chaucer.To wealth or sovereign power he naught applied. Fairfax.
The character or personality of a hero. "Three years ofheroship." Cowper.
A half wolf; a mongrel dog, between a dog and a wolf.

Wrought or worked in or among other things; worked into anyfabric so as to from a part of its texture; wrought or adorned, aswith figures.His mantle hairy, and his bonnet sedge, Inwrought with figures dim.Milton.
The act or process of puncturing. See Acupuncture.
Of or pertaining to the Ichneumonidæ, or ichneumon flies.-- n.
Without dimensions; having no appreciable or noteworthy extent.Milton.
